description: Creates a signing-order group for a CONFIGURABLE signature request in DRAFT (403 otherwise). type: Document (a round of documents; its id is the groupId for signature_request_add_document), Signatory (a round of signatories; the groupId for signature_participant_create) or DocumentSignatory (links one document to a round; needs documentId). Creating a CONFIGURABLE request pre-creates a Document and a Signatory group at index 1: use them for the first document and signatory (read their ids with signature_group_list) and create only the additional rounds (index 2, 3…). Add participants with linkToAllDocuments:true (signature_participant_create; the bulk call links them itself) so DocumentSignatory groups are generated at the right index; without it they stay unlinked to documents and signature_coordinate_set fails with 'Signatory not found'.
name: signature_group_create
